hackathon_name: DEV Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge — Week 4: Ghost in the Machine

thesis.winning_argument: The one concept where the open-source AI is genuinely load-bearing (not decoration), unlocks three prize tracks at once, and writes up into a gripping first-person developer build-story (the heaviest-judged axis).
thesis.evidence: Substitution test PASSES — remove TabPFN and the app degrades to a git-stats page. Two distinct AI roles: TabPFN classifies death-mode from a feature table; Groq open-weight model narrates the coroner's report.
thesis.demo_obligation: Judge WITNESSES the full loop live on the deployed URL: paste a public GitHub repo URL -> feature table -> TabPFN death-mode verdict + confidence -> Groq coroner's-report narration that types out -> shareable death-certificate card.
thesis.hero_flow: Paste public GitHub repo URL -> feature table -> TabPFN classify -> Groq narrate -> death certificate card.
thesis.invariants: TabPFN is the SOLE provider of the death-mode classification (load-bearing); the open-weight model is the open-source-AI core; no fabricated verdicts or narration; one URL -> one certificate.
thesis.drift_tripwires: Must NOT become a ghost-story generator, a haunted-terminal chatbot, or a git-stats page; TabPFN must not be a bolt-on; narration must not be the headline over the forensic verdict.

verified_patterns: tabpfn-client 0.7.0: pip install tabpfn-client; from tabpfn_client import TabPFNClassifier; set_access_token(token) or TABPFN_TOKEN env avoids browser login; .fit(X,y)/.predict_proba(X)
groq SDK: pip install groq; from groq import Groq; client.chat.completions.create(model='openai/gpt-oss-20b', messages=[...], stream=True); iterate chunk.choices[0].delta.content (guard None)

GitHub REST: GET /repos/{o}/{r}/commits (commit.author.date; per_page=100; r.links.next for pagination); GET /repos/{o}/{r} (pushed_at, created_at, stargazers_count, open_issues_count, archived); GET /repos/{o}/{r}/contributors (sorted desc = bus-factor); Bearer token -> 5000/hr vs 60/hr unauth
